name: quark-onnx-eval-runner
description: Manually verify that the Quark ONNX skill family behaves correctly across the four contract categories (routing, planning, artifact, recovery). Use when maintainers need to confirm that ONNX routing, planning, artifact generation, or error recovery skills still work as expected. Trigger for "verify the ONNX skills", "smoke-test ONNX routing", "check ONNX skill behavior", or before tagging a release that touches `quark-onnx-*` skills. This is a governance tool for skill maintainers, not for end users running ONNX model accuracy evaluation — for the latter use the upstream Quark ONNX evaluation tooling.
